text: Using the linear estimate tau_mem ~ 1/(1 - rho) with leak rate alpha = 1, a reservoir with rho = 0.9 has an effective memory horizon of about:
explanation: tau_mem ~ 1/(1 - 0.9) = 1/0.1 = 10 steps, matching the ~10-step dependency of NARMA-10 (hence rho ~ 0.9 is a good match). 100 steps corresponds to rho = 0.99, 1 step to very small rho, and '90 steps' is a distractor from misreading 0.9*100.
